theory.title: Adjetivos terminados en -ed y -ing
theory.explanation: Usa adjetivos terminados en -ed para describir cómo se siente una persona y adjetivos terminados en -ing para describir aquello que provoca ese sentimiento. Por ejemplo, un viaje puede ser tiring (agotador) y una persona puede sentirse tired (cansada).
theory.tip: La persona suele sentirse -ed; la situación suele ser -ing.

content.passage: Last spring, Marta travelled to Edinburgh for the first time. The flight was delayed, which was frustrating, but she was relieved when the airline found another connection. She joined a guided tour that was surprisingly interesting. The guide told fascinating stories about the old town, and Marta was amazed by the architecture. By the end of the day she was exhausted, but she felt that the experience had been worthwhile.

items.prompt: Describe a journey that was exciting or disappointing.
items.modelAnswer: One of my most exciting journeys was a train trip through the Scottish Highlands. The views were beautiful, but the train stopped for nearly an hour because of a signal problem. I was disappointed at first, then enjoyed talking to other passengers.

items.prompt: Talk about a place you found fascinating.
items.modelAnswer: I found Kyoto fascinating because modern shops stand beside quiet temples and traditional gardens. I spent a morning walking through the old streets and trying local food. The city felt busy but peaceful at the same time.

items.prompt: What makes a long journey tiring?
items.modelAnswer: A long journey becomes tiring when you sit in the same position for hours. I also find it difficult when there is little space or when connections are delayed. I usually take water, a book and comfortable clothes.

items.prompt: Describe a time you felt relieved while travelling.
items.modelAnswer: I felt relieved when I reached the airport after a very slow journey through heavy traffic. I had left home early, but the road was almost blocked. I arrived just before boarding began and was glad I had allowed extra time.

items.prompt: Have you ever been surprised by a destination?
items.modelAnswer: I was surprised by Porto because it was much hillier than I expected. The streets were narrow, and the river views were wonderful. I had planned to visit museums, but I spent most of the time exploring on foot.

items.prompt: Talk about an experience that was confusing at first.
items.modelAnswer: At first, I found the ticket machines in a foreign station confusing because the instructions were in a language I did not know. A local passenger showed me how to choose the right ticket. After that, travelling became much easier.

items.prompt: What kind of travel activities are you interested in?
items.modelAnswer: I'm interested in walking tours, local food markets and small museums. They help me understand a place beyond the main tourist attractions. I also enjoy travelling by train because I can watch the landscape.

items.prompt: Describe a memorable view or landscape.
items.modelAnswer: One view I remember is the sunrise over a lake in the mountains. The water was completely still, and the hills were reflected on its surface. We stopped for a few minutes and took photographs before continuing our walk.

items.prompt: How do you feel when travel plans change?
items.modelAnswer: When travel plans change, I try to find out the reason and check the available alternatives. I may feel disappointed, but getting angry rarely helps. I contact anyone waiting for me and make a new plan.

items.prompt: Recommend an enjoyable day trip and explain why.
items.modelAnswer: I recommend a day trip to a nearby coastal village. Visitors can walk along the harbour, try fresh seafood and follow a path to a lighthouse. It is easy to reach by bus and offers a relaxing change from city life.

content.audioTranscript: A: We are planning a trip next month. B: Where are you going? A: We are travelling to a historic town. B: Have you booked the journey? A: Yes, and we have printed the tickets. B: Which station will you use? A: The central one. B: Is there a local guide? A: Yes, we made a booking online. B: Do you know the platform? A: It is shown on the app. B: What will you visit? A: The museum and the market. B: Are you learning about local customs? A: Yes, and we are staying at a small hotel. B: Enjoy your arrival!
